blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Ladner: the detached houses benchmark was $1,284,100 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 4.2%; over three months it fell 3.4%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.9%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 9.1%; over 5 years it was little changed (+0.8%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over 10 years it rose 26.4%.
Detached houses against other home types in Ladner
Ladner: the detached houses benchmark of $1,284,100 sits $364,300 above the townhomes benchmark of $919,800 (140% of it) and $697,700 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $586,400 (219% of it).

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Ladner?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Ladner that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in Ladner?

faq.q: Where can I see all Ladner homes?
